verdict.rationale: Attio documents a public REST API and publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 specification at api.attio.com/openapi/api, linked from its endpoint-reference docs page, so a first-party API reference exists. Nothing in the evidence shows that reference is interactive, offers a try-it console, or includes runnable examples. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive API explorer or playground, runnable request examples, and hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.
